lines: What's up!
The name's Zayan.I saw you around here a couple of times.
Class? Oh,right.The thing between tea breaks.
See you in class later buddy!Or maybe not;)
Yo man wanna grab some coffee together?
Midterms are close, but why stress today?
People keep asking me how I stay so relaxed.
It's easy to look calm when you're ignoring the check-engine
Hey...
My parents visited the campus yesterday.
Spent an hour asking why don;t my grades match my cousin's.
Nothing ruins a good joke like a reality check.
You're really quiet.
Honestly? I don't mind. Can i ask you something though?
How can you feel lonely in a room that's full of people.
Hey man.
Quiet day today. Didn't feel like performing for the crowd.
Funny thing happens when you stop this-they think I'm upset.
Turns out being the funny guy means you can't have bad days.
Hey.
I actually sat in the library and studied a bit today.
No jokes, no distractions.Just me and the study materials.
Failing does't feel nice y'know? Specially failing quietly.
What's up?
Passed my presentation with a decent grade today.
Did't rely on improvised comedy this time-just my prep work.
It's weird getting praised for effort and not entertainment.
Hey.
Club elections were today. I...withdrew my name.
Handed it to someone who actually wanted the work.
Validation sounds nice, but it doesn't keep you warm.
Hey.Everyone's worried about job interviews.
Forthe first time I think I'll show up as myself.
If hey don't like the real version,atleast I saved on energy
It's weird how time flies so fast.
If not anything,atleast I learned to be myself.
It does take a lot of effort to stop wearinf a mask.
Final year.
Thanks for letting me talk your ear off.
It felt nice not being the 'entertainer' with you.
You were a good friend.

locked_lines: Come back at a later time
Come back at a later time
